cases.why: Paraphrase of the same gotcha.

memory.title: Auth must run before rate limiting
memory.body: axum applies .layer() bottom-up: the AuthLayer call must come AFTER .layer(RateLimitLayer) in router.rs so auth executes first. Wrong order: TenantId extension is missing, limiter falls back to the shared `anonymous` bucket, junk traffic empties it and every tenant sees 429s.

memory.title: API keys and passwords hashed with argon2id
memory.body: Keys look like lk_<8 char prefix>_<secret>. Prefix stored plaintext for lookup, secret hashed argon2id m=19MiB t=2. Never log the full key.

memory.title: Hash verification must run in spawn_blocking
memory.body: argon2 verify costs ~40ms CPU. Called inline in the key middleware it pins tokio workers and tail latency on sign-in and key auth goes to seconds under load. Wrap in spawn_blocking.

memory.title: Metered quota increments on 429 responses too
memory.body: MeteringLayer sits outside RateLimitLayer, so throttled requests still consume the monthly allowance. Ticket BILL-88 open, product undecided.

memory.title: sqlx prepared statements break behind pgbouncer
memory.body: Error: prepared statement "sqlx_s_1" already exists. Set statement_cache_capacity(0) on PgConnectOptions.

memory.title: Presigned URLs fail when the host clock drifts
memory.body: S3 answers 403 RequestTimeTooSkewed / SignatureDoesNotMatch if the signing pod clock is >5 min off. Seen on one node where chrony was dead.

memory.title: Outbound HTTP client defaults
memory.body: http_client/mod.rs: reqwest, 10s total timeout, 3 retries with backoff on GET/PUT/DELETE only.

memory.title: Pooled connections die after NAT idle timeout
memory.body: AWS NAT gateway drops idle flows after 350s without RST; reqwest reuses the dead socket and the first call after a quiet period gets connection reset. pool_idle_timeout must be < 350s.

memory.title: Runners set HTTPS_PROXY
memory.body: CI runners export HTTPS_PROXY; reqwest honors it, so requests to wiremock on 127.0.0.1 go to the proxy and fail with 502 only in CI. Build test clients with .no_proxy().

memory.title: Jobs are at-least-once
memory.body: A job that outlives the visibility timeout is handed to another worker while the first still runs. Handlers must be idempotent.

memory.title: Feature flags evaluated once per request
memory.body: flags.rs loads the tenant flag set once and stores it in request extensions; flips apply to new requests only.

memory.title: Load test 2026-08: 1.8k rps per pod
memory.body: k6 against staging, 4 vCPU pods. CPU bound on argon2 during key auth; Postgres at 35% CPU. Next bottleneck is JSON serialization of invoice lists.

memory.title: Quota vs rate limit
memory.body: Quota = monthly request allowance per plan, enforced in MeteringLayer against usage counters. Rate limit = short-window GCRA in Redis. Different errors: 402 quota_exceeded vs 429.

memory.title: Tenant plan cached 5 min in-process
memory.body: plans.rs caches the plan per tenant for 5 min. After plan upgrades the new limits and allowance apply only when the entry expires.

args.title: Run argon2 verify off the tokio workers
args.body: verify costs ~40ms CPU; inline in the auth middleware it stalls the runtime. Use spawn_blocking.

memory.title: Money is i64 minor units

memory.title: Tax calc move to Stripe Tax paused

memory.body: Row-level security reads app.tenant_id. With pgbouncer transaction pooling a plain SET sticks to the server connection and the next client transaction runs as the previous tenant. Always SET LOCAL inside the tx.

memory.title: ledgerctl backfill is not resumable
memory.body: backfill prints its checkpoint to stdout only. If it dies, rerun with --from-id <last printed id>; there is no state file.

memory.title: Feature flags evaluated once per request
memory.body: flags.rs loads the tenant flag set once and stores it in request extensions; flips apply to new requests only.

memory.title: OTLP exporter drops spans under load
memory.body: Batch queue default 2048; at ~1k rps spans are dropped silently. Raised max_queue_size to 16384 in telemetry.rs for api pods.

memory.title: x-request-id propagation

memory.title: Secrets loaded once at boot

memory.title: Moving rate limiting to Envoy: rejected
memory.body: Envoy global rate limit service would need plan limits synced from Postgres; extra moving part. Latency cost ~2ms was fine. Kept in-process.

memory.body: OPTIONS preflight carries no Authorization header, so AuthLayer returned 401 and browsers blocked the call. CorsLayer must be the outermost layer.

memory.title: Rotating the outbound signing secret needs a dual-sign window
memory.body: Customers verify our deliveries with the old secret for a while. Sign with both secrets (two v1= entries) for 24h after rotation.

memory.title: Annual invoice period off by one day west of UTC
memory.body: Period start used UTC midnight. Monthly path fixed in #412; annual path still wrong for America/* tenants.

memory.title: Integration tests share one database
memory.body: tests/ uses one Postgres; tests run in parallel. Reusing tenant 'acme' across tests causes random failures. Create a unique tenant per test via TestTenant::new().

memory.title: wiremock Stripe mocks must match Idempotency-Key
memory.body: Without matching the Idempotency-Key header, a retried request hits the mock for a different test step and assertions fail intermittently.

memory.title: Redis maxmemory-policy must be volatile-lru
memory.body: With allkeys-lru Redis evicted usage:{tenant} counters (no TTL) under memory pressure and customers were under-billed. Only keys with TTL may be evicted.

memory.title: Tenant plan cached 5 min in-process
memory.body: plans.rs caches the plan per tenant for 5 min. After plan upgrades the new limits and allowance apply only when the entry expires.

args.title: CORS preflight fails for x-request-id header
args.body: Browsers sending x-request-id get preflight rejected: header missing from CorsLayer allow_headers.

cases.why: Same gotcha as m25 in different words; m04 is another cross-tenant incident.

memory.title: Auth must run before rate limiting
memory.body: axum applies .layer() bottom-up: the AuthLayer call must come AFTER .layer(RateLimitLayer) in router.rs so auth executes first. Wrong order: TenantId extension is missing, limiter falls back to the shared `anonymous` bucket, junk traffic empties it and every tenant sees 429s.

memory.title: JWKS cached, refreshed every 10 min
memory.body: src/auth/jwks.rs keeps the IdP key set in memory. Unknown kid forces a refetch, at most once per 30s; requests wait on that fetch (~300ms from eu-west).

memory.title: Service tokens bypass tenant scoping
memory.body: aud=internal tokens carry no tenant claim, so TenantId is never set. Handlers reachable by internal callers must call require_tenant() explicitly. INC-212: /invoices returned rows from every tenant to the reporting service.

memory.title: Rate limiter: Redis GCRA per tenant per route group
memory.body: Keys rl:{tenant}:{group}. Groups: default, writes, exports. Limits come from the tenant plan. Implemented as a Lua script, one round trip.

memory.title: Retry-After must be integer seconds
memory.body: We sent Retry-After: 0.42; the Python SDK int() parse crashed and the Go SDK treated it as 0 and hot-looped. Round up to whole seconds.

memory.title: Usage metering flushes Redis counters every 60s
memory.body: metering.rs INCRs usage:{tenant}:{yyyymm} in Redis and a task copies to Postgres usage_records every 60s. Up to 60s of counts lost on crash; accepted by product.

memory.title: Proration double-charged on retried plan change
memory.body: INC-230: the plan change handler used the HTTP request id as Stripe idempotency key; client retry got a new request id and Stripe created a second proration invoice. Key is now plan_change_id.

memory.title: Money is i64 minor units
memory.body: All amounts are i64 minor units plus ISO currency. Exponent table in money.rs (JPY 0, KWD 3). Converting through f64 caused 1-cent reconciliation drift.

memory.title: Tax calc move to Stripe Tax paused
memory.body: tax.rs has tax_v2 path behind flag tax_v2 (off everywhere). Blocked on EU OSS registration. Do not drop the legacy tax_rates table yet.

memory.title: Metered quota increments on 429 responses too
memory.body: MeteringLayer sits outside RateLimitLayer, so throttled requests still consume the monthly allowance. Ticket BILL-88 open, product undecided.

memory.title: Postgres pool: 20 per pod via pgbouncer transaction mode
memory.body: pool.rs sets max_connections=20. pgbouncer runs in transaction mode, so no session state and no server-side prepared statements.

memory.title: Presigned URLs fail when the host clock drifts
memory.body: S3 answers 403 RequestTimeTooSkewed / SignatureDoesNotMatch if the signing pod clock is >5 min off. Seen on one node where chrony was dead.

memory.title: Invoice soft-delete half done
memory.body: Added deleted_at; queries in storage/invoices.rs filter it. reports/ module not updated yet, still counts deleted invoices. Never hard delete invoices.

memory.title: RLS tenant GUC must be SET LOCAL
memory.body: Row-level security reads app.tenant_id. With pgbouncer transaction pooling a plain SET sticks to the server connection and the next client transaction runs as the previous tenant. Always SET LOCAL inside the tx.

memory.title: Outbound HTTP client defaults
memory.body: http_client/mod.rs: reqwest, 10s total timeout, 3 retries with backoff on GET/PUT/DELETE only.

memory.title: Feature flags evaluated once per request
memory.body: flags.rs loads the tenant flag set once and stores it in request extensions; flips apply to new requests only.

memory.title: /healthz checked the DB and caused restart storms
memory.body: Liveness hit Postgres; during PG failover every pod failed liveness and kubelet restarted all of them at once. Liveness must be process-only; readiness may check deps.

memory.title: Graceful shutdown must finish under the grace period
memory.body: terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 30; axum graceful shutdown timeout was 60 so SIGKILL cut in-flight Stripe event handling. Now 25s.

memory.title: Secrets loaded once at boot
memory.body: config.rs reads AWS Secrets Manager at startup only. DB password rotation needs a rolling restart.

memory.title: Moving rate limiting to Envoy: rejected
memory.body: Envoy global rate limit service would need plan limits synced from Postgres; extra moving part. Latency cost ~2ms was fine. Kept in-process.

memory.title: CORS preflight rejected when auth runs first
memory.body: OPTIONS preflight carries no Authorization header, so AuthLayer returned 401 and browsers blocked the call. CorsLayer must be the outermost layer.

memory.title: Outbound webhook retries done, DLQ UI not started
memory.body: webhooks_out: exponential backoff up to 24h is merged. Dead-letter table exists; admin UI to list and replay deliveries not started.

memory.title: Tenant plan cached 5 min in-process
memory.body: plans.rs caches the plan per tenant for 5 min. After plan upgrades the new limits and allowance apply only when the entry expires.

args.title: Plain SET app.tenant_id leaks across pooled connections
args.body: In pgbouncer transaction mode the server connection moves to another client; a session SET makes the next transaction run as the previous tenant under RLS. Use SET LOCAL.
